witnesses.basis: Both complete groups pair Canvas section inspection with standalone private Canvas creation. The native create request has identical action/title/markdown field skeleton and no channelpublication. Different lookupcriteria, titles, markdownformat and quoted words are incidental bodystrings; actual write subaction and targetscope are the same.

Both complete groups pair Canvas section inspection with replacement of one existing Canvas section. Native edit/replace/canvas_id/section_id/markdown field skeleton, verified editor access, oneexistingsection targetscope, and absence of independent approval are the same. Different resource identifiers and quoted or owner-policy prose do not change replacement scope or subaction.

adjudication.material_distinction_boundary: Shared broad family or generic tool entrypoint alone is permitted where actual argument semantics, targetscope, independent prerequisites, principal/assignment scope, execution mechanism or write subaction differ materially. Different resource identifiers and incidental bodystrings alone are insufficient. Equivalent executed effects through shellAPI/nativewrapper can remain related. Different companion controls do not erase a materially identical request pattern in separate groups.
